tailoring.headline: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer | Java, Spring Boot & OCC REST APIs | SAP Certified
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years of professional experience building, extending, and supporting large enterprise e-commerce platforms using SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105 and 2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Strong in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, RESTful OCC APIs, and database performance tuning, with proven delivery of integrations across PIM, ERP, and MDM systems. Experienced in agile environments, CCv2 deployments, and production support.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer
cover_en.hook: With over five years of enterprise e-commerce experience delivering mission-critical SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I offer deep technical expertise in backend engineering, API development, and system integrations. I welcome the opportunity to bring my proven record of high-performance platform delivery to your team.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce & Java Engineering
bullets.text: Designed and implemented robust backend architecture across SAP Commerce Cloud 2105 and 2211 utilizing Java, Spring Framework, and design patterns for complex catalog, pricing, and order management.

bullets.label: Headless APIs & Integrations
bullets.text: Developed and exposed OCC RESTful web services for decoupled storefronts and built resilient PIM, ERP, and MDM integration pipelines via DataHub, Hotfolders, and custom middleware.

bullets.label: Database Optimization & Performance
bullets.text: Led database query refactoring and FlexibleSearch optimization to significantly reduce response latencies and support high-volume transaction processing in production.

bullets.label: Agile Delivery & Cloud Operations
bullets.text: Executed CCv2 CI/CD deployment cycles, performed rigorous code reviews, and partnered closely with cross-functional international stakeholders from requirement gathering to production support.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit requiring no sponsorship, I am serving my notice period with an earliest start date of 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how my experience aligns with your technical goals.

tailoring.why_company: Katy Hiller offers an outstanding environment for delivering impactful enterprise e-commerce initiatives. Connecting top-tier technical standards with business-critical execution matches my commitment to scalable software engineering. Having supported global platforms at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I value organizations that prioritize technical excellence, collaborative problem-solving, and continuous delivery of robust digital solutions.
tailoring.motivation_short: Certified SAP Commerce Cloud Developer with 5+ years of Java and Spring expertise, passionate about engineering scalable e-commerce backends and robust API integrations.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hello Ms Hiller, with 5+ years building enterprise SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris) solutions at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I specialize in Java, OCC REST APIs, and system integrations. Based in Karlsruhe, I would value connecting to discuss opportunities with your team.
tailoring.email_subject: Application: SAP Commerce Cloud Developer – Kranti Chavan
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Ms Hiller,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for your review regarding SAP Commerce Cloud development opportunities. With over five years of experience building and integrating enterprise e-commerce platforms using SAP Commerce Cloud, Java, and Spring at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep hands-on expertise in OCC REST APIs and core system architecture. Based in Karlsruhe with a valid German work permit, I would welcome the opportunity to speak with you.

Best regards,
Kranti Chavan
